messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — routing-policy anomaly detected (variant-mismatch spikes). A subset of requests are being routed to incorrect model variants across regions. Severity: P1. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/1825448670

sre-oncall: ack, I'm on it. which region/variant combos are we seeing? any customer reports yet?

maya: seeing a pattern — us-west requests sometimes hit eu-central cache entries. cache key shows model=v2 but served model=v1 outputs. spike started ~10:05 UTC after routing policy rollout.

eric: that rollout was mine, I pushed an update to fallback policy that allows cross-region variant fallback to reduce throttles. I suspected it might be risky for cached responses. rolling back now if needed.

rameen: logs snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T10:07:12Z INFO route_choose shard=us-west request_id=aa1 model=v2 routed_to=eu-central cache_key=model:v2|region:eu-central cache_hit=true served_variant=v1
2026-03-15T10:07:12Z WARN mismatch request_id=aa1 expected_variant=v2 served_variant=v1
2026-03-15T10:07:18Z INFO route_choose shard=us-west request_id=aa8 model=v2 routed_to=eu-central cache_key=model:v2|region:eu-central cache_hit=true served_variant=v1
```

maya: we also have replayed traces where KV cache key generation omitted region tag for a small percentage of requests due to a config flag flip. that allowed reuse across regions.

eric: rolling back routing-policy to strict-match now. command: `redwoodctl config set routing.fallback=STRICT --env=prod --rollout=immediate`

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by eric: routing-policy rollback (id: dp-20260315-1143). Canary 5% -> 100% in progress.

sre-oncall: while rollback is rolling, we should purge the offending cache keys to avoid stale mismatches. plan: run targeted purge for model=v2 keys in eu-central shards that reported hits.

maya: agreed. purge command (internal admin API):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood.internal/cache/purge \
  -d '{"shards":["eu-central-1"], "prefix":"model:v2|"}'
```

rameen: started purge for eu-central shards now. progress: 12/24 shards completed.

sre-oncall: monitoring error rate and mismatch alerts. can someone watch customer-facing erroring requests in AP/NA dashboards?

cs-liz: CS is seeing 3 inbound tickets referencing odd completions — AcmeCorp (high), Finly (med), and internal QA. I've flagged AcmeCorp as high priority and created a hotfix notice draft.

maya: metrics: mismatch-rate peaked at 4.3% at 10:08 UTC, now down to 0.6% after purge and rollback. latency unaffected.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. routing-policy at prod = STRICT, rollout id dp-20260315-1143 succeeded.

rameen: purge complete for eu-central shards. verified no further cache hits with wrong region. sample logs show expected behavior now:
```
2026-03-15T10:22:34Z INFO route_choose shard=us-west request_id=zz9 model=v2 routed_to=us-west cache_key=model:v2|region:us-west cache_hit=false
```

eric: sorry for the churn. root cause hypothesis: the new fallback poly allowed cross-region cache reuse and a side-effect in key generation (missing region tag for ~0.5% requests) produced incorrect cache collisions.

cs-liz: update sent to affected customers: AcmeCorp notified of brief incorrect variant exposure ~10:05-10:27 UTC. offering audit logs and assistance.

maya: current status — mitigation complete, monitoring good, no ongoing errors. will keep alert thresholds up for 2 hours.

sre-oncall: assigning postmortem/owner: eric will own action items (config guard, stricter rollout gating, unit test for cache key).

eric: will open postmortem and PR to add unit tests for cache key generation + rollout checklist to block cross-region fallback without explicit opt-in. ETA for PR: EOD.

noah: taking handoff for night-oncall. leaving followups to eric. please DM if anything regresses. :hand: 

sre-oncall: handing over to @noah. all alerts silenced for this incident. incident-bot summary: duration 22m, impacted ~12k requests, 2 customers with visible effect, remediation: rollback + targeted cache purge.

cs-liz: tagging support tickets and closing triage loop. will coordinate postmortem customer comms with eric after postmortem draft.

everyone: reactions: :white_check_mark: for rollback/purge, :memo: for postmortem owner.

incident-bot: incident resolved (P1 -> resolved). follow-up: postmortem required, timeline & action items must be posted within 48h. Incident link: https://redwood.internal/ops/postmortems/1825448670
